name: smwsprites-super-mario-world
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Numbered Platform
description:
A numbered platform from Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island, found in levels like Don't Look Back (4-2).
It's a platform which allows you to jump on only a limited amount of times.

Can be used as a standalone sprite or in combination with a block. Uses the Map16 tile number for how often you can jump on one.

Read the readme for more details.
